items.title: Merck (MRK) Plans Early HIV Pill Licensing Across 129 Countries
items.summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) has outlined a global access plan for its investigational once-monthly oral HIV prevention pill, alimatravir. The company is pursuing early voluntary licensing and regional manufacturing across 129 low and middle income countries ahead of Phase 3 completion. New public private partnerships and regulatory engagement aim to prepare health systems for a rapid rollout if the drug is approved. items.summary: Moderna's Q2 revenue tops estimates, but shares fall after its phase III norovirus vaccine study misses early success criteria.

items.title: Moderna Stock Has Doubled This Year. Can Earnings Keep the Rally Alive?
items.summary: Moderna  posted a narrower per-share loss in its latest quarter, but shares traded slightly lower as the company’s earnings report highlighted the drugmaker’s ongoing struggle to break away from its pandemic-driven business model.  Moderna  posted a loss of $1.97 a share, narrower than the loss of $2.01 Wall Street had anticipated, and slimmer than the per-share loss of $2.13 reported last year.  The drugmaker reiterated its full-year guidance of 10% revenue growth, evenly split between U.S. and international sales.
